title: app_theme.dart — make progressIndicatorTheme.color theme-aware
objective: Replace the hardcoded color: AppColors.primary in both light() and dark() progressIndicatorTheme blocks of lib/ui/core/theme/app_theme.dart with the respective ColorScheme.primary value, so progress indicators inherit a brand-correct color in both brightness modes.
description: Currently both ThemeData builders declare progressIndicatorTheme: ProgressIndicatorThemeData(color: AppColors.primary, linearTrackColor: ..., circularTrackColor: ...). This hardcodes the same brand color regardless of brightness, ignoring the dark ColorScheme entirely. linearTrackColor and circularTrackColor already pull from the respective ColorScheme.surfaceContainerHighest, so they are theme-aware — only the `color` field is wrong. The fix swaps the two lines: light() uses lightColorScheme.primary; dark() uses darkColorScheme.primary. This brings progress indicators into alignment with the rest of the theme, which already routes primary-tinted content (FilledButton background, OutlinedButton border, TextButton foreground) through the ColorScheme.

anchors: lines 88-92 — light() progressIndicatorTheme block (EDIT line 89: color: AppColors.primary -> color: lightColorScheme.primary)
lines 190-194 — dark() progressIndicatorTheme block (EDIT line 191: color: AppColors.primary -> color: darkColorScheme.primary)

diff_spec.light:
@@ lines 88-92 @@
       progressIndicatorTheme: ProgressIndicatorThemeData(
-        color: AppColors.primary,
+        color: lightColorScheme.primary,
         linearTrackColor: lightColorScheme.surfaceContainerHighest,
         circularTrackColor: lightColorScheme.surfaceContainerHighest,
       ),
diff_spec.dark:
@@ lines 190-194 @@
       progressIndicatorTheme: ProgressIndicatorThemeData(
-        color: AppColors.primary,
+        color: darkColorScheme.primary,
         linearTrackColor: darkColorScheme.surfaceContainerHighest,
         circularTrackColor: darkColorScheme.surfaceContainerHighest,
       ),

acceptance_criteria: Inside the light() builder, progressIndicatorTheme.color is `lightColorScheme.primary` (no remaining occurrence of `color: AppColors.primary` in the light block)
Inside the dark() builder, progressIndicatorTheme.color is `darkColorScheme.primary` (no remaining occurrence of `color: AppColors.primary` in the dark block)
linearTrackColor still references lightColorScheme.surfaceContainerHighest in light() and darkColorScheme.surfaceContainerHighest in dark() — unchanged
circularTrackColor still references lightColorScheme.surfaceContainerHighest in light() and darkColorScheme.surfaceContainerHighest in dark() — unchanged

No other lines in app_theme.dart are modified — chipTheme, snackBarTheme, filledButtonTheme, outlinedButtonTheme, textButtonTheme, cardTheme, appBarTheme, inputDecorationTheme, iconTheme, dividerTheme remain unchanged
flutter analyze lib/ui/core/theme/app_theme.dart returns no errors

grep_evidence: rg -n 'color: AppColors\.primary' lib/ui/core/theme/app_theme.dart must return zero matches inside progressIndicatorTheme blocks (other usages of AppColors.primary in the file are allowed and unchanged)
rg -n 'color: lightColorScheme\.primary' lib/ui/core/theme/app_theme.dart must return at least one match (the new progressIndicatorTheme line)
rg -n 'color: darkColorScheme\.primary' lib/ui/core/theme/app_theme.dart must return at least one match (the new progressIndicatorTheme line)

no_op_outside_scope: Do not modify any other component theme. Do not modify app_color_schemes.dart or any token file. Do not change the existing AppColors.primary usages elsewhere in the file (chipTheme.selectedColor, secondarySelectedColor still reference AppColors.primary / AppColors.primaryLight by design).
